message.Title: Public Preview: Service tags for inbound rules in network security perimeter

Body.Content:
Announcing the public preview of 'service tags as inbound rules' support for third-party customers in network security perimeter. 

This new capability simplifies how customers manage access to in network security perimeter-protected resources by allowing them to use service tags as part of network security perimeter access rules when connecting to supported third-party services. 

Learn more.
